about: The hull track's rig-look parts (ticket 584, wave 576-1B of the rig look ladder #576): one asset at the track's attach slot, one part per look step and the base look beside them. The thresholds are Systems' table (#157, comment 6300543785) in the model's hull counter, which the registry (#577) maps to `levels.hull` purchases, and the names Progression's (comment 6300549964); the wiring (#585) reads them from the rig-look registry, not from here.
